verdict.rationale: Firebase's own auth docs state that upgrading to Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform unlocks multi-factor authentication and SAML and generic OpenID Connect support, along with multi-tenancy, which covers the MFA and enterprise SSO elements of the story. This rests on a single first-party sentence, and the capability sits behind an upgrade rather than the base Auth tier. missing for 10: documentation that MFA can be enforced (required) for all users rather than just offered, detailed SAML/OIDC configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
